name: Mongolia: the Constitution and the laws in force (legalinfo.mn)
label: Mongolia
record_note: legalinfo.mn publishes each law's current consolidated text, for a few laws the original text, and the list of amending acts, but no dated versions in between. So each law has its current text as published on 2026-10-28 (dated that day, authored by the publisher, with Amended-by: trailers), and, where the site has it or no amending act is listed, its original text on its own in-force date (authored by the law). The wording between the two is not published; tools/in_force_on.py warns (Unknown-from:).

dates.commit: original: the law's own in-force date ("дагаж мөрдөх огноо"); current text: the retrieval day
dates.time: 12:00 Asia/Ulaanbaatar (UTC+8; UTC+9 in the summers of 1983-1998, 2001-2006, 2015-2016)

author.original: the law itself (title and adoption date), law-<id>@legalinfo-mn.invalid

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Mongolia; the publisher's notes such as "/... -ний өдрөөс эхлэн дагаж мөрдөнө/" (applies from) stay in the text and are in data/amendments.csv

default_reach.rule: no retroactive application unless the law says so
default_reach.meaning: civil legislation is not applied retroactively except where a law provides otherwise; administrative normative acts likewise; laws making an infringement or offence harsher do not apply retroactively, milder ones do
default_reach.authority: Civil Code (Иргэний хууль) art. 5.1; General Administrative Law (Захиргааны ерөнхий хууль); Law on Infringements (Зөрчлийн тухай) art. 1.4; as published on legalinfo.mn
